subject: Social Media
title: Screen Time Tracking
description: A micro-lesson that makes Screen Time Tracking usable.

hook.text: Apple added Screen Time in 2018. Users saw their daily totals and panicked. Four hours? Five? How?

buildup.text: Awareness is the first step. Most people vastly underestimate their daily screen time by 50% or more.

discovery.text: Tracking alone reduces usage by about 20%. Simply seeing the number creates a feedback loop.

twist.text: But people game their own limits. Override the timer, switch apps, or use a second device. Self-control has limits.

climax.text: The most effective trackers show what you're missing: exercise, sleep, reading. Opportunity cost is the real motivator.

punchline.text: You can't manage what you don't measure.

quiz.question: By how much do most people underestimate their screen time?
